assessment_scope: Complete declared fictional Savia/FLUJO hackathon submission, repository-only independent source/technical-receipt review and bounded offline replay. R0-R18 core, generic/domain separation, development history, pipeline/publication, AI/provider/voice and inquiry/fleet orchestration, ML/evaluation, analytics and ElevenLabs comparison. No target/prior score, peer assessment, other repository, web/provider access, installation, deployment, tracked edit or branch change.

dimensions.name: Technical judgment
dimensions.reason: Ordered deterministic policy, owner/snapshot/query binding, explicit host consent, exact signed admission, attempted-write uncertainty and independent receipts are deeply implemented and 1078 current guarded core checks pass. Generic FLUJO/domain boundary and deployment provenance are sound. Narrow documented native-card routing omission and incompletely joined wider operational integrations prevent full marks; synthetic policy is correctly disclosed.

dimensions.name: AI engineering
dimensions.reason: Real two-reviewer structured completions, durable owner-scoped inquiries, pinned fleet recovery, permitted facts, safe fallbacks and native canonical voice/playback ACK/recovery are implemented and supported by source-pinned receipts. 183 committed files match the latest voice receipt. Reviewers make bounded suggestion choices, exact 100-agent customer completion is absent, broad answer/voice quality is unqualified and native card imperatives fail the request gate.

dimensions.name: Data engineering
dimensions.reason: Versioned lineage, contracts/quarantine, structural deterministic deduplication, ownership-isolated serving, writer lock, immutable snapshots and report-before-CURRENT publication are strong. Seven synthetic replay invariants pass and six published tables reconcile 5899720 rows arithmetically. Private data was not rerun; crash durability, stale-writer recovery/retention and multi-filesystem guarantees remain outside demonstrated scope.

dimensions.name: ML/evaluation
dimensions.reason: Rejecting template/fraud label claims is justified; fixed bilingual TF-IDF/logistic, keyword baseline, abstention tradeoffs, heldout hashes, similarity checks, confusion/errors and paired uncertainty reproduce. Raw router 94/120 versus keywords 70/120; abstention 65/120 reduces human misses 3/30 to 1/30 but adds 43 unnecessary handoffs. Labels remain AI-proposed; eight audited examples are automated agreement only. Frozen 100-case Luna oracle/capacity audit reproduces but uses ten phrases, ties the deterministic baseline and bypasses deployed Savia; representative human answer quality is unmeasured.

dimensions.name: Data analytics
dimensions.reason: Data defects drive product decisions; read-only metadata analytics preserve privacy, outcome semantics and explicit denominators. Four replay invariants and host-outcome tests pass. Operating evidence keeps token/cache cost, latency, language usefulness, fallback and infrastructure workloads separate. Durable per-case token/cost linkage, lifetime action attribution and representative customer/ROI cohorts are missing; ElevenLabs positioning is not an experimental quality comparison.

defects_and_gaps.description: Documented card imperatives fail native banking admission because action verbs omit bloquea/bloqueie. Expected explicit request delegation to authenticated chat and controlled consent; actual native turn completes with no tools/delegation despite perfect scripted ASR. Question controls admit. Text/API controlled card flow tests pass; successful native nondelegation does not invoke dictation fallback.

October5 exact fleet customer attempt root provider workspace returnedHTTP404 before delegation; zero accepted fleet result. This prevents crediting100-agent customer completion, while separate two-reviewer customer and infrastructure records retain their scope.

Full120 labels remain proposed AI ground truth; eight-case automated sample is not human adjudication. No representative real-customer answer quality, economic benefit or newly accepted100-agent workload.

Current host analytics reports latest slots without exact workflow-turn or card lifetime attribution; durable per-case token/cost and real human pickup, push/email and multi-day reliability remain unmeasured.

limitations: No submission-wide blocker demonstrated for the declared fictional dispute/card/inquiry prototype; narrow voice entry defect remains real.
Only this frozen repository was inspected; no peer/prior rating, other repository, chat, website or provider was consulted.
Offline tests use generated stores, fixture data and scripted transports; they do not establish current public availability or fresh model behavior.

Historical external run receipts were inspected within their pins; private underlying infrastructure/source dataset records were not rerun and external authenticity cannot be independently established here.
Known frozen router procedure is an unchanged replay, not a new blind test. Full labels are AI-proposed and real-customer prevalence/quality is absent.
Luna100 workload ties deterministic baseline, repeats ten phrases and bypasses deployed Savia; turn overlap is not GPU simultaneity or collaboration.
Native exact captions and sample/playback receipts do not establish waveform/text alignment, physical microphone or hearing. No live voice/card journey or forced browser fallback was executed.
Atomic CURRENT replacement is not power-loss durability or a transaction across filesystems; stale locks and snapshot retention require operator handling.
Historical core/extension/public test counts are not pooled across overlapping scopes.
ElevenLabs comparison is repository positioning with dated vendor claims, not an externally verified controlled quality/latency/economic experiment.
Scores are independent reviewer judgments rather than official organizer ratings; no threshold was supplied or targeted.
